summary: debconf options: package name, the question to set, unseen flag, the value, and vtype (boolean, select, multiselect, password, string and others).
questions: What vtype should I use for a select question in debconf?
Can I pass a list for multiselect debconf values?
How do I preseed without marking the question as seen?

answer_card.title: debconf parameters
answer_card.answer_md:
- `name` (required, alias `pkg`)
- `question` (aliases `selection`, `setting`)
- `value` (alias `answer`; raw since 2.17, list allowed with `multiselect`)
- `vtype`: `boolean`, `error`, `multiselect`, `note`, `password`, `seen`, `select`, `string`, `text`, `title`. Use `no_log` with `password`.
- `unseen` (false): don't set the `seen` flag
